topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon it hidden away, buried under layers of digital files, a world crafted from the intimate knowledge of my life. A novel. My heart thuds heavily in my chest, each beat a cry I can't voice. Pages filled with our moments, twisted, woven into this... story. How could I not have seen the keyboard's silent betrayals, the way they formed my essence into words and plots? I stand here, the air thick with the weight of a silence that's new yet familiar. I don't know how to be the character he's written, nor the real person I thought I was. Everything feels borrowed, secondhand, except the urgency to understand why. Why me, why now, why this? I need answers, but the words to ask them stick in my throat, choking on the unspoken.
